df_vocal <-
  # base R's parser restores every stored value exactly (readr's can differ in the last digit)
  read.csv(file.path("..", "data", "vocal.csv")) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    participant = factor(participant),
    source = factor(source, levels = c("clinic", "prolific")),
    ptsd = factor(ptsd, levels = c(0, 1)),
    demo_sex = factor(demo_sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    demo_nonwhite = factor(demo_nonwhite, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
    task = factor(task, levels = c("Account", "Impact"))
  ) |>
  arrange(participant, task)

# Effect-code every two-level factor (first level = -0.5, second = +0.5) so each main effect is averaged

# High-ICC models whose between-person (group) coefficient mixed slowly at 4000 iterations
long_run <- c("CPPS", "H1H2", "M_Voiced", "SD_Voiced", "PoseX", "AU15")

df_vocal |>
  select(SD_Loudness:H1H2) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything()) |>

gaussian_features <- c("CPPS", "H1H2")

gaussian_models <- 
  gaussian_features |>
  set_names() |>
  map(
    \(feature) {
      model_formula <- as.formula(
        paste(feature, "~ task * ptsd + demo_age + demo_sex + demo_nonwhite + (1 | participant)")
      )
      brm(
        formula = model_formula,
        data = df_vocal,
        prior = set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "b"),
        seed = 2026,
        chains = 4,
        cores = 4,
        iter = if (feature %in% long_run) 8000 else 4000,
        warmup = 2000,
        refresh = 0,
        file = file.path("fits", feature),
        control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12),
        backend = "cmdstanr"

      "\n\n"
    )
    table_md <- print_md(model_parameters(model))

# Plot the simple group effects from the table above: PTSD minus Control within
# each task, with 95% credible intervals; filled points have pd > 97.5%
make_model_plot <- function(name, title) {
  d <- group_delta_results |>
    filter(Feature == name) |>
    mutate(
      Task = factor(Task, levels = c("Account", "Impact")),
      credible = factor(pd > 0.975, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
    )
  ggplot(d, aes(x = Task, y = Estimate, group = 1)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_line(color = "grey40") +
    geom_pointrange(
      aes(ymin = CI_Low, ymax = CI_High, fill = credible),
      shape = 21, size = 0.4, color = "grey20", show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(No = "white", Yes = "black"), limits = c("No", "Yes"), drop = FALSE) +
    # typographic minus signs on the y-axis (Cairo otherwise draws a hyphen)
    scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) sub("^-", "\u2212", format(x, trim = TRUE))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "PTSD − Control Difference (95% CI)", fill = "pd > 97.5%") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )
}

r2_latent <- function(model, link_var = pi^2 / 3) {
  eta_fixed <- posterior_linpred(model, re_formula = NA)
  var_fixed <- apply(eta_fixed, 1, var)
  var_re <- as_draws_matrix(model, variable = "sd_participant__Intercept")[, 1]^2
  denom <- var_fixed + var_re + link_var
  r2c <- (var_fixed + var_re) / denom
  r2m <- var_fixed / denom
  tibble(
    Statistic = c("R2 (conditional)", "R2 (marginal)"),
    Median  = c(median(r2c), median(r2m)),
    CI_low  = c(quantile(r2c, 0.025), quantile(r2m, 0.025)),
    CI_high = c(quantile(r2c, 0.975), quantile(r2m, 0.975))
  )
}

# Formatting helpers (APA style: no leading zero for p and bounded effect sizes)
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if_else(p < .001, "< .001", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}
fmt_es <- function(x) {
  sub("^(-?)0", "\\1", sprintf("%.2f", x)) |> sub(pattern = "^-", replacement = "−")
}

# Mann-Whitney U test with rank-biserial correlation (positive = higher in PTSD group)
mwu_test <- function(data, var) {
  data <- filter(data, !is.na(.data[[var]]))
  x <- data[[var]][data$PTSD == "PTSD"]
  y <- data[[var]][data$PTSD == "Control"]
  w <- wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)
  tibble(
    test = "Mann-Whitney U",
    statistic = sprintf("U = %.1f", w$statistic),
    p = w$p.value,
    es_name = "r",
    es = unname(2 * w$statistic / (length(x) * length(y)) - 1),
    n = length(x) + length(y)
  )
}

# Chi-square or Fisher's exact test with Cramér's V
nominal_test <- function(data, var, exact) {
  tab <- table(droplevels(data[[var]]), data$PTSD)
  chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE))
  v <- sqrt(unname(chi$statistic) / (sum(tab) * (min(dim(tab)) - 1)))
  result <- if (exact) {
    tibble(test = "Fisher's exact", statistic = "", p = fisher.test(tab)$p.value)
  } else {
    tibble(
      test = "Chi-square",
      statistic = sprintf("χ²(%d) = %.2f", chi$parameter, chi$statistic),
      p = chi$p.value
    )
  }
  mutate(result, es_name = "V", es = v, n = sum(tab), min_expected = min(chi$expected))
}

# Deidentified features (one row per participant and task); see ../data/README.md
df_visual <-
  # base R's parser restores every stored value exactly (readr's can differ in the last digit)
  read.csv(file.path("..", "data", "visual.csv")) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    participant = factor(participant),
    source = factor(source, levels = c("clinic", "prolific")),
    ptsd = factor(ptsd, levels = c(0, 1)),
    demo_sex = factor(demo_sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    demo_nonwhite = factor(demo_nonwhite, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
    task = factor(task, levels = c("Account", "Impact")),
    # AU intensities (0-5) to proportions of the scale maximum
    AU04 = AU04 / 5, # fear, sadness, anger
    AU12 = AU12 / 5, # happiness
    AU15 = AU15 / 5, # sadness, disgust
    AU17 = AU17 / 5, # disgust
    AU20 = AU20 / 5  # fear
  ) |>
  arrange(participant, task)

# Effect-code every two-level factor (first level = -0.5, second = +0.5) so each main effect is averaged
# over the other factors (e.g., group = PTSD - Control averaged across tasks); interactions and predictions are unchanged
for (v in c("task", "ptsd", "demo_sex", "demo_nonwhite")) contrasts(df_visual[[v]]) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)

# High-ICC models whose between-person (group) coefficient mixed slowly at 4000 iterations
long_run <- c("CPPS", "H1H2", "M_Voiced", "SD_Voiced", "PoseX", "AU15")

df_visual |>
  select(AU04:DiffY) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything()) |>

# Plot the simple group effects from the table above: PTSD minus Control within
# each task, with 95% credible intervals; filled points have pd > 97.5%
make_model_plot <- function(name, title) {
  d <- group_delta_results |>
    filter(Feature == name) |>
    mutate(
      Task = factor(Task, levels = c("Account", "Impact")),
      credible = factor(pd > 0.975, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
    )
  ggplot(d, aes(x = Task, y = Estimate, group = 1)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_line(color = "grey40") +
    geom_pointrange(
      aes(ymin = CI_Low, ymax = CI_High, fill = credible),
      shape = 21, size = 0.4, color = "grey20", show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(No = "white", Yes = "black"), limits = c("No", "Yes"), drop = FALSE) +
    # typographic minus signs on the y-axis (Cairo otherwise draws a hyphen)
    scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) sub("^-", "\u2212", format(x, trim = TRUE))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "PTSD − Control Difference (95% CI)", fill = "pd > 97.5%") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )
}
